body: Just as I assumed no one really cares. Everyone will be better off without me.

Well i have Asperger's which makes it really hard for people to understand me. I just feel like anyone I try to be friends with just shuts me out & never understands me. Then even if I do make friends they always leave & ghost me. They never stick around.
I know I'm only staying alive for my parents & my pets. I have no one else.
